product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk provides an AI-powered business phone system, conversation intelligence, and autonomous voice agents for sales and support teams at small and mid-sized businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: CloudTalk describes business calling, AI-powered call intelligence, and autonomous voice agents in one platform for sales and support teams at small and mid-sized businesses. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/our-story

pricing_page.notes: CloudTalk has a public page presenting its pricing plans. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: CloudTalk's customer-story index explicitly names Pipedrive and Circle Gym as users and links to their case studies. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/customer-stories | named_customers.0: The customer-story index describes Pipedrive's teams using CloudTalk. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/customer-stories | named_customers.1: The customer-story index names Circle Gym in a case study about AI Voice Agents. employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/17944841

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile names Toronto as headquarters, consistent with the official contact address. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/17944841 ; https://www.cloudtalk.io/contact | hq_country: The official contact page labels the headquarters location 'Canada HQ.' Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/contact

founded_year.notes: CloudTalk explicitly states that it was founded in 2016. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/our-story

eng_blog.notes: The developer blog includes two qualifying technical articles: Jaroslav Tomeček's technical-backlog article discusses production queue load balancing, while Josef Lapka's integration article discusses authentication chains and implementation. Their profiles identify them as Director of Engineering and CPTO. Confidence is reduced because the article templates label both authors 'Senior Copywriter,' conflicting with their professional profiles. Sources: https://www.cloudtalk.io/blog/rnd ; https://www.cloudtalk.io/blog/rnd/how-do-we-work-with-technical-backlog/ ; https://www.cloudtalk.io/blog/rnd/building-smarter-integrations-with-cursorai-lessons-from-the-bullhorn-project/ ; https://linkedin.com/in/jaroslavtomecek ; https://linkedin.com/in/joseflapka

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains multiple guides, including Quickstart, Authentication, and a full API Reference. Source: https://developers.cloudtalk.io/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable all-open-positions board, updated November 5, 2026, lists nine roles. None has a qualifying AI, ML, data-science, scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title. Source: https://apply.workable.com/cloudtalk/jobs.md

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, and Deepgram
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list explicitly associates OpenAI with Conversation Intelligence, Anthropic with voice-agent configuration, Google and AssemblyAI with speech-to-text, and ElevenLabs and Deepgram with voice-agent processing. Source: https://www.cloudtalk.io/sub-processors

Source: https://trust.cloudtalk.io/ | compliance_certs.4: The trust center publishes a PCI DSS SAQ A 4.0 entry, supporting a public PCI DSS compliance claim rather than independent certification. hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Toronto posting seeks an inbound Sales Development Representative and explicitly says it is an immediate hire. Source: https://apply.workable.com/cloudtalk/jobs/view/07B73E44B9.md

launched_6mo.notes: CloudTalk's November 9, 2026 announcement launches its rebuilt AI Sales Dialer, a major feature release within the six-month window.
